name: dvr
description: Directory verification rule (E2EE 3.4) as a pure function: each case is a full input (bundle bytes, claimed leaf, witnessed head with STH and w1 signatures, server STH, audit and consistency paths, pin, clock) and the expected outcome: ok with the key to seal to, or err dvr <step>. Heads: sig = Ed25519(online, "cx1/sth" || 0x00 || u64(size) || root || u64(at)), w1 = Ed25519(w1, "cx1/witness" || ...).

cases.what: leaf under the witnessed head, cs=2 client
cs=1-only client picks ek1
leaf newer than the witnessed head: fresh STH consistent with it -> provisional
server STH older than 24 h
leaf newer than the witnessed head and no STH
fork: the server's STH is not consistent with the witnessed head
unpublished substitute: not included under the witnessed head
split-view: same size as the witnessed head, different root
mirror unreachable, no CX_TRUST=tofu
witnessed head without a witness signature
tier D (CX_TRUST=tofu): the server's fresh STH only
pending bundle (legacy contested publish) never seals
daily index lists a higher seq: refetch
pin regression on seq
pin regression on mail_policy (e2ee -> both)
ik differs from the pinned ik
pinned peer, same ik
no ek for the current epoch and no lk_ok: stale-bundle
stale epochs but lk_ok and unpinned: last resort to lk2
lk_ok but the peer is pinned: refuse
tampered bundle bytes
expired bundle
